name: LLDAP Self-Hosted Lightweight LDAP
free_limit: GPL-3.0-licensed lightweight self-hosted LDAP authentication and user-management server with web UI, SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL backends and no vendor subscription or published user quota for the core server.
watch_out: Runs on infrastructure you operate; server, database, backups, TLS, email delivery and maintenance may cost money. Intentionally does not implement all LDAP server features, and GPL-3.0 obligations apply to redistribution; no hosted free account or commercial support is included.
